items.html: And behold, the mouth of the womb is narrow, and the fetus cannot come out from there except with great difficulty. And it is because all the lights that Ima has in her NHY depart from them and rise there, into her belly. Then very many lights are found there, and that vessel cannot bear them, and the womb is split through its mouth — since there is an actual split there, it is split and widened, and then the lights of Tvuna, which are the master of the house, push ZA outward, who is the guest, and he is born.
